answer: The woolcomber bench holds the heated combs, and the fleeces wait washed in the basket. Tin shade lanternmaker oilhall writ — a writ shade lanternmakers set twice oilhall oil tallies hold. dune draws the wool through the hot combs and pulls the short fibres out. grove winds the combed sliver into a top and ties it off. atlas packs the tops in the chest and chalks the count on the lid. To copy this tally a man must comb 48 fleeces without one top breaking at the draw, and the next still snaps where the comb ran cold.
